query: For my 63-year-old male inpatient, among males aged 58–68, what is the median duration (days) of a single heparin/enoxaparin prescription?
final_sql: SELECT (SELECT MEDIAN(p.duration) FROM prescriptions p JOIN patients pt ON p.subject_id = pt.subject_id WHERE pt.gender = 'M' AND pt.age BETWEEN 58 AND 68 AND p.drug IN ('heparin', 'enoxaparin')) AS median_duration;
